description: Melidir wears a dark olive-green wool tunic with gold knotwork trim at the sleeve ends and hem, over cream linen sleeves. A dark green-brown checked wool cloak with knotwork edging and fringed ends wraps his shoulders, fastened by a round interlaced metal brooch. A brown leather belt with a round knotwork buckle and long decorated hanging end secures his waist. Loose brown trousers tuck into brown leather boots with crossed lacing. His head and hands are bare; no armor or weapons are visible.
